scope: Two things only: (1) verify a small number of the 9A273AA product images (official source + integrity + actual visual content), (2) check whether up to 2 additional HYPERX catalog rows, in different peripheral categories where possible, have a real confirmed Product page -- using already-known category/navigation links first, with bounded discovery only if needed. No other brand, no Kingston, no HIPER, no wide HyperX census.
allowed_hosts_reason: The only host confirmed official for this brand family (Stage 8/8.1/11). Product images are served from hyperx.com/cdn/shop/files/... on the same host, not a separate CDN subdomain.
seed_urls_note: All 5 collection URLs and the product URL were already found as first-party navigation links on the Stage 8.1/Stage 11-confirmed QuadCast 2S product page fixture -- none is guessed. Category pages are used only to look for real product links; individual product page URLs are only fetched once actually found in a category page's own links, never assembled from a guessed slug pattern.
image_verification_note: 2 of the 9 already-known image URLs from Stage 11 (the main photo and one angle photo) -- a small number, not all 9 -- fetched with a byte-preserving, completeness-classified mechanism (reused from Stage 10.1/10.3's adaptation of Stage 8.6) and visually inspected.
robots_txt_policy: hyperx.com/robots.txt fetched first (fresh this stage, not assumed from Stage 11), honoring any Disallow rules under User-agent: *.
stop_conditions: max_requests_total or max_category_pages_to_check or max_candidate_product_pages_to_verify reached
HTTP 403/429/challenge_confirmed on hyperx.com -> stop the host, record the gap (challenge_suspected alone does not stop, per Stage 8.1/11 precedent)
redirect off hyperx.com -> aborted, not followed
a category page yields no real product-page link matching the candidate model name -> record as not found, do not substitute a similar model
robots.txt disallows a candidate path -> skip, record why
explicit_non_goals: No brute-forcing of URLs, model codes, or slugs
No wide HyperX census beyond the up-to-2 additional rows this stage picks
No Kingston, HIPER, or any other brand network activity
No renewed manual/document search for 9A273AA this stage
